mapper.select: select id, student_no, name, gender, age, class_name, phone from student order by id
select id, student_no, name, gender, age, class_name, phone from student where student_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by id
mapper.insert: insert into student (student_no, name, gender, age, class_name, phone) values (#{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{className}, #{phone})
mapper.update: update student set student_no = #{studentNo}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, class_name = #{className}, phone = #{phone} where id = #{id}
